## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you started.

### Install eegtemple in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure eegtemple package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to eegtemple
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub [repository](https://github.com/bkowshik/temple-of-eeg-decoding):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/bkowshik/temple-of-eeg-decoding.git
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/eegtemple/)

``` sh
$ pip install eegtemple
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub [repository](https://github.com/bkowshik/temple-of-eeg-decoding)’s [pages](https://bkowshik.github.io/temple-of-eeg-decoding/). Additionally you can find package manager specific guidelines on [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/eegtemple/).
